title: Singular Stability Estimates for Passive Gamma Emission Tomography of Spent Nuclear Fuel
summary: We study the joint recovery of attenuation and source coefficients from the attenuated X-ray transform, motivated by passive gamma emission tomography of spent nuclear fuel. Both coefficients are constant on known, disjoint disks of equal radius representing fuel rods. The surrounding moderator has known attenuation and zero source. We use tangential singularities of the data to give a sufficient condition on the geometry and coefficients for unique joint reconstruction from full data.
